uniform_results.low_basis_deletion: B=(C_rho minus T) union H, |T|=|H|, H has tag degree >=R.
uniform_results.nilpotent_tag_corollary: For g(T)=T^R, the whole positive fan, at all weights, has at most 2*(D-1)*(R-1)+2 states for D,R>=2; C_rho is its exact basis.
uniform_results.cheap_cyclotomic_regions: Coherent bases are integral with index one; pointwise regional initials are the same in every characteristic, by the established two-circuit unimodularity theorem.
uniform_results.power_lift: For every odd k, I_k=I_1(X^k,Y^k,Z^k), length 8*k^3; fan counts 9 outside characteristic two and 6 in characteristic two. Three rational cones have coherent integer index 2^(k^3).

scope: Uniform overlap and arithmetic proofs with bounded exact controls. Equal-period coherent torsion and its power lifts do not establish an amplification or characteristic change for distinct coprime prime periods. Classical matroid sensitivity, lucky-prime and monomial-substitution principles are not claimed as new.
